# Sensitivity studies (auto-generated by analysis/sensitivity.py)

## 1. Weight/compute precision on Jetson AGX Thor

Peak scales 2x per halving of precision (BF16 -> FP8 -> FP4); activations kept at the same width as weights except FP4 (FP8 activations).

| Workload | BF16 ms | FP8 ms | FP4 ms | Budget ms |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| pi0 (3B) | 41.9 | 20.9 | 10.9 | 500 |
| pi0-FAST (3B) | 1,124.8 | 562.4 | 282.4 | 500 |
| OpenVLA (7.5B) | 396.6 | 198.3 | 100.4 | 200 |
| SmolVLA (0.45B) | 10.9 | 5.5 | 2.8 | 500 |
| GR00T N1.7 (3B) | 19.2 | 9.6 | 4.9 | 667 |
| Matrix-Game 2.0 (1.3B, streaming) | 143.6 | 71.8 | 35.9 | 480 |
| DreamZero WAM (14B) | 2,116.8 | 1,058.4 | 529.2 | 143 |
| Llama-3.1-8B decode b=1 ctx=8K | 58.9 | 29.5 | 15.7 | 33 |

## 2. Flow-matching / diffusion step count (pi0 on Thor, BF16)

| Steps | Latency ms (weights re-read every step) | Latency ms (expert weights held on-chip) | Weight share of expert traffic |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 20.7 | 20.7 | 97% |
| 2 | 23.1 | 20.8 | 97% |
| 4 | 27.8 | 20.9 | 97% |
| 5 | 30.1 | 21.0 | 97% |
| 10 | 41.9 | 21.3 | 97% |
| 20 | 65.4 | 22.0 | 97% |

## 3. KV traffic vs context: LLM grows linearly, VLA prefix is fixed by sensor config

| Llama-3.1-8B context | KV read per token (MB) | KV share of per-token traffic |
|---|---|---|
| 2,048 | 268 | 2% |
| 8,192 | 1,074 | 7% |
| 32,768 | 4,295 | 22% |
| 131,072 | 17,180 | 53% |

pi0 reads its 816-token prefix cache (15 MB) 10x per chunk = 150 MB, vs 6.2 GB of expert weights.

## 4. Working sets vs on-chip SRAM

| Workload | Looped-stage weights @FP8 (MB) | @FP4 (MB) | Resident cache BF16 (MB) |
|---|---|---|---|
| SmolVLA (0.45B) | 97 | 48 | 4.9 |
| GR00T N1.7 (3B) | 415 | 208 | 0.7 |
| pi0 (3B) | 311 | 156 | 15.0 |
| Matrix-Game 2.0 (1.3B, streaming) | 1,250 | 625 | 973.2 |
| DreamZero WAM (14B) | 11,954 | 5,977 | 7,667.7 |

The *looped stage* (action expert / DiT / video denoiser) is re-executed every step; if its weights fit on-chip the step loop becomes compute-bound instead of DRAM-bound.
